title: If you are struggling
note: Always available, never behind a flag: free confidential lines with how to reach them. Opens in place.
text: Settings Early version Early Letters is an early version, and it can make mistakes. Some things may change. Export a copy of your letters now and then. Plan Plus: Read together whenever you like, and more books. Children Asha Add a child Writing Spoken language The language you speak your letters in. Reminders Off Appearance Match this phone Export your book Every letter and recording, free, any time. Recently deleted Letters you delete wait here for 30 days. Recordings Storage Language packs and space on this phone. Private by default. Never sold, never used for ads. Help and legal Help Write to us If you are struggling The early months can be very hard. You do not have to carry it alone. These lines are free and confidential. National Maternal Mental Health Hotline Call or text 1-833-852-6262, any time, in English or Spanish. 988 Lifeline Call or text 988, any time. Postpartum Support International Call 1-800-944-4773 and a trained volunteer calls you back. If you or your baby are in danger right now, call 911.
